entries.columnsContract: `offer_id PK, candidate_package_id FK, package_revision, package_digest, acceptance_basis_digest, state(open|accepted|rejected), handoff_decision_id NULL, handoff_decision_digest NULL, handoff_receipt_id NULL, handoff_receipt_digest NULL, terminal_evidence_digest NULL, offered_at_ms, closed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `offer_id`与`acceptance_basis_digest`必须分别等于8.6.18从final `CandidatePackage@1`计算的`CandidateIntakeAcceptanceBasis@1`公式结果，且同事务存在唯一`ProcurementCandidateOfferAvailableMessage@1` Outbox；`UNIQUE(candidate_package_id,package_digest,acceptance_basis_digest)`；同一Candidate至多一个open Offer。open时全部handoff/terminal/closed列为NULL；accepted要求Decision ID、Receipt ID/digest、terminal Evidence及closed time非NULL，Decision digest沿用既有nullable合同；rejected要求全部handoff/terminal/closed列非NULL且逐项等于`LibraCandidateRejectedMessage@1`，`terminal_evidence_digest=receiptDigest`；terminal列写后immutable，相同Offer重放不得新增row、Outbox或改写不同终态；`INDEX(state,offered_at_ms)`

clean initialization建立唯一revision 0 row；`head_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.subject-continuity-head@1",headId,currentRevision}))`；任何改变active Subject集合、exact continuity relation或accepted Episode scope的事务都必须expected-revision CAS并加1，不能按时间戳伪造；Handoff A、Resolved Identity exact anchor publish与Subject terminal均使用同一head

entries.columnsContract: `intake_decision_id PK, decision_revision, decision_kind(accepted_resolution|rejected_acceptance), offer_id, candidate_package_id, package_revision, package_digest, acceptance_basis_digest, candidate_delivery_snapshot_digest, expected_continuity_head_revision NULL, expected_continuity_head_digest NULL, committed_continuity_head_revision NULL, candidate_continuity_set_digest NULL, candidate_episode_scope_digest NULL, match_cardinality NULL|none|one|multiple, matched_subject_set_digest NULL, episode_overlap_digest NULL, accepted_result NULL|new_subject|season_extension, target_subject_id NULL, expected_target_status NULL, expected_target_intake_revision NULL, expected_target_continuity_set_digest NULL, expected_target_episode_scope_digest NULL, committed_target_intake_revision NULL, committed_subject_continuity_set_digest NULL, committed_subject_episode_scope_digest NULL, accepted_payload_digest NULL, rejection_schema_ref NULL, rejection_id NULL, primary_rejection_code NULL, rejection_reason_set_digest NULL, rejection_digest NULL, decision_digest, decided_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `decision_revision=1`且`UNIQUE(offer_id)`；`intake_decision_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.intake-decision-id@1",offerId}))`；common Offer/Package/Acceptance Basis/Snapshot逐项匹配正式Delivery；无法取得完整Snapshot属于Delivery integrity/system failure，不伪造Rejected Decision。`accepted_resolution`要求continuity/match/overlap、accepted result/target、committed Subject digest及accepted payload完整非NULL，全部rejection列为NULL；其`decision_digest`逐字节等于`SubjectContinuityResolutionDecision@1.decisionDigest`。`rejected_acceptance`要求全部continuity/head/match/target/accepted列为NULL，rejection列完整非NULL；其`decision_digest`逐字节等于`IntakeRejectionDecision@1.decisionDigest`。`new_subject`要求target是Libra分配的新ID；`season_extension`要求one match/zero overlap及完整target CAS。Continuity无匹配、多匹配或Episode overlap仍是`new_subject`，不得成为rejection。同一Candidate/Package digest只允许一个accepted Decision的partial unique index；不同Acceptance Basis的新Offer可以各自保留Rejected Decision，但任何后续Accepted仍受该唯一约束；immutable，不接受调用者指定既有Subject或伪造head值

entries.columnsContract: `intake_decision_id FK, ordinal, subject_id FK, expected_subject_status(active), expected_subject_intake_revision, expected_subject_continuity_set_digest, expected_subject_episode_scope_digest, claim_kind, claim_namespace, claim_key, candidate_claim_digest, subject_claim_digest, subject_claim_provenance_kind(candidate|resolved_identity), subject_claim_provenance_ref, witness_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(intake_decision_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(intake_decision_id,subject_id)`；none为0 row、one恰为1 row、multiple恰为按subjectId UTF-8 bytes最小的2个distinct matching Subject witness；每个Subject选择按claim tuple/provenance稳定排序的第一项exact交集作为证明；`witness_digest=SHA-256(JCS(完整row business value excluding intakeDecisionId/ordinal/witnessDigest))`；它证明Decision所需0/1/N cardinality，不声称保存multiple分支的无界全量匹配集合

`PK(intake_decision_id,subject_id,episode_key)`；只允许match cardinality=one时保存Candidate Episode scope与唯一Subject current scope的完整交集，按episodeKey排序；`overlap_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.episode-overlap-member@1",subjectId,episodeKey}))`；zero overlap合法为0 row；multiple/none不执行overlap并为0 row；aggregate formula按8.6.18

entries.columnsContract: `intake_decision_id FK, reason_ordinal, reason_code, evidence_ordinal, evidence_schema_ref, evidence_id, evidence_digest, reason_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(intake_decision_id,reason_ordinal,evidence_ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(intake_decision_id,reason_ordinal,evidence_schema_ref,evidence_id,evidence_digest)`；每个reason ordinal至少一行，reason code按8.6.18 Handoff A closed precedence去重排序，组内Evidence按`evidence_schema_ref,evidence_id,evidence_digest`的UTF-8 bytes升序且唯一；同一reason ordinal全部row的reason code/digest相同；`reason_digest=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"handoff-a-rejection-reason@1",reasonCode,evidenceRefs}))`；全部rows必须精确重建`IntakeStructuredRejection@1`的Reason集合，immutable；`INDEX(intake_decision_id,reason_ordinal,evidence_ordinal)`

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, intake_decision_id FK, outcome(accepted|rejected), offer_id, candidate_package_id, package_revision, package_digest, candidate_delivery_snapshot_digest, subject_id NULL, subject_intake_revision NULL, subject_continuity_head_revision NULL, subject_continuity_set_digest NULL, subject_episode_scope_digest NULL, accepted_payload_digest NULL, libra_binding_set_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, rejection_id NULL, primary_rejection_code NULL, rejection_reason_set_digest NULL, rejection_digest NULL, receipt_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(intake_decision_id)`；同一Candidate/Package digest最多一个accepted Receipt的partial unique index，新的Acceptance Basis/Offer可以分别保留rejected Receipt。accepted要求Subject、accepted payload、Binding/Control列全部非NULL且rejection列全NULL，重建`SubjectAndTransferReceipt@1`，其`ReceiptEnvelope.scopeDigest=accepted_payload_digest`；rejected要求Subject/accepted/Binding/Control列全NULL、rejection列全非NULL，重建`IntakeRejectionReceipt@1`，其`ReceiptEnvelope.scopeDigest=IntakeRejectionDecision.decisionDigest`。两种Receipt的Snapshot digest均逐字节等于对应Decision；相同marker重放不新增Receipt或消息

entries.columnsContract: `subject_id PK, structure_kind, status, intake_revision, current_continuity_set_digest, current_episode_scope_digest, current_identity_revision NULL, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms, terminal_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `status`至少区分`active|abandoned|completed`；new Subject固定`intake_revision=1`，每次Season extension CAS加1；continuity/Episode digest由本域relation rows按8.6.18重建；`current_identity_revision=NULL`是尚未发布Resolved Product Identity的唯一合法初值，正整数时显式复合FK指向`libra_product_identity_revisions(subject_id,revision)`；`INDEX(status,subject_id)`；Subject不保存Arca Shelf Entry/Deck状态
